title: ALERTCalifornia (UC San Diego)
short_description: UC San Diego program using AI, camera networks, and remote sensing to monitor wildfires and climate — engages students in real environmental research.

title: UC San Diego Research Experience for High School Students (REHS)
short_description: Eight-week summer research at the San Diego Supercomputer Center, pairing students with UCSD mentors on computing, data science, and life-science projects.

title: Salk Institute High School Summer Scholars
short_description: Competitive summer placements in active Salk Institute labs spanning neuroscience, genetics, and cancer biology.

title: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research (SIMR)
short_description: Eight-week biomedical research internship placing high schoolers in Stanford labs across immunology, cancer biology, bioengineering, and more.

title: Research Science Institute (RSI)
short_description: Free, highly selective summer research program hosted at MIT combining coursework with original STEM research under mentors.

title: Garcia Summer Research Program (Stony Brook University)
short_description: Materials-science research program where students work in university labs on polymers and nanomaterials, often toward publications and patents.

title: Boyce Thompson Institute Plant Research Program (Cornell)
short_description: Paid summer plant-science and genomics research internship on the Cornell campus.

title: Fermilab TARGET Summer Internship
short_description: Summer program at the national particle-physics laboratory introducing students to physics, engineering, and scientific computing.

title: Jackson Laboratory Summer Student Program
short_description: Mentored genetics and genomics research at a leading biomedical institute, with a stipend and independent project.

title: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory — Partners for the Future
short_description: Long Island high schoolers conduct mentored research alongside CSHL scientists during the academic year.

title: Rockefeller University Summer Science Research Program (SSRP)
short_description: Seven-week laboratory research immersion in New York City with a focus on the biological and biomedical sciences.

title: NIH High School Summer Internship Program (SIP)
short_description: Paid summer research in NIH labs across biomedical, behavioral, and public-health science.

title: UT Southwestern STARS Summer Research
short_description: Summer biomedical research placements for Texas high school students in university labs.

title: Simons Summer Research Program (Stony Brook University)
short_description: Matches high schoolers with Stony Brook faculty for hands-on research across STEM disciplines, ending in a written report and poster.

title: Clark Scholar Program (Texas Tech University)
short_description: Intensive seven-week research program giving a small cohort one-on-one work with faculty across many fields.

title: Genentech Futurelab
short_description: Biotech company programs introducing local high school students to careers and hands-on work in the life sciences.

title: NASA OSTEM High School Internships
short_description: Paid internships across NASA centers where high schoolers work with scientists and engineers on real aerospace and STEM projects.

title: Smithsonian Institution Youth Internships
short_description: Internships across Smithsonian museums and research centers spanning science, history, art, and conservation.

title: Google Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI)
short_description: Three-week introduction to computer science for graduating seniors, with coding projects and mentorship from Google engineers.

title: Microsoft High School Internship
short_description: Paid internships giving students aged 16+ exposure to software engineering, product, and research at Microsoft.

title: Bank of America Student Leaders
short_description: Paid summer internship with a local nonprofit plus a leadership summit in Washington, D.C., for civic-minded juniors and seniors.

title: MIT MITES Summer
short_description: Free, rigorous six-week residential STEM program at MIT for rising seniors from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Girls Who Code Summer Programs
short_description: Free virtual computer-science programs teaching coding, web, and career skills to students who identify as girls or nonbinary.

title: Regeneron Science Talent Search
short_description: The nation's oldest and most prestigious science and math competition for high school seniors presenting original research.

title: Pennsylvania Governor's School for the Sciences
short_description: Free five-week residential program at Carnegie Mellon immersing students in college-level science and mathematics.

title: Summer Science Program (SSP)
short_description: Residential research experience where teams tackle a real problem in astrophysics, biochemistry, genomics, or synthetic chemistry.
